note: Small family RV park on the east side of Mount Pleasant, formerly Updog RV Park, with shade trees and a small pond. Old Threshers week by phone. --Claude
summary: Renamed KJ's Campground & RV Park (updogrvpark.com dead; kjcampandrv.com live); posted $40/$42 incl. tax (undated) with GS/military 10% and Passport America; 30/50 amp full hookups; pull-through; showers, laundry; open year round per its Firefly page (was year_round false); Firefly search behind reCAPTCHA, unread.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted nightly $40 (30 amp) / $42 (50 amp) including tax and utilities, $36 / $37.80 with the 10% Good Sam or military discount; under US$50. The rate page carries NO date (live 2026-11-03; footer '(c) 2023 by Updog RV Park', though the KJ's branding on it postdates the Updog name) and the Firefly engine's search was refused by reCAPTCHA, so no dated 2024+ engine quote - not retried.
